title: Database and Information Systems Design (Django/MySQL web applications)
weeklyTopics: Environment setup: Python, Django, MySQL install (macOS/Windows)
Midterm exam: SQL SELECT queries and equivalent Django ORM QuerySets against a heritage-sites database
Meeting 7-10: Django ORM, MySQL data loading, REST API exercises
Django ORM QuerySet examples and extra-credit ORM exercises
Final project: building a full Django + MySQL + REST API web application (heritagesites-style)
workloadNotes: Final project graded on a 2000-point rubric (GitHub repo 50, logical data model 100, MySQL database 650, Django app 700, Django REST API 500 points) rather than percentages, so no percent breakdown is given. Weekly exercises tied to specific class meetings (4 through 10) plus a mid-course exam.
